questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All engines are rockets.

All planes are rockets.

Conclusions:

(I) Some engines are planes.

(II) All planes are engines.
questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All engines are rockets.

All planes are rockets.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7155f711538ae2f8b121c0bd45e660ee272b6b15633dc10d3da43e0e84087e3c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/474c2ff040b6c375a2308b3b9364aea9e9072fd989255677da09ae72f4e982cb.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some engines are planes. - False (because there is no direct relation between engines and planes so it can be possible but not definite)

(II) All planes are engines. - False (because there is no direct relation between engines and planes so it can be possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is "Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows".

questions.question:
Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G, and K, are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only K sits to the left of G. Only four people sit between K and C. Only E sits between F and D and F is not an immediate neighbour of C.

Who sits at the extreme right of the line?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G, and K, are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only K sits to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cf882886648a9d55b92eec29735a07b7146c0de02277c72e481c2c24c1549de.png] 

2) Only four people sit between K and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/287e145fe13fd55ad8c6fd7f0329c049329e32a54b17998ed7b779470c77cb5e.png] 

3) Only E sits between F and D and F is not an immediate neighbour of C.

After positioning E, F and D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebb242206050b2acfe5496667a1a4b9bd7f7200c7e81c2b6a30aa33aca408eaa.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, B sits at the extreme right of the line.

Hence, **"Option 3" **is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a row of people, Marshall is sitting 13th from the left end and 36th from the right end. What is the total number of persons in the row?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Position of Marshall from the left = 13th

Position of Marshall from the right = 36th

So,

Total number of people = Position of Marshall from the left + Position of Marshall from the right - 1

= 13 + 36 - 1

= 49 - 1 = 48.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

In this question, a statement is followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.

Statement: The price of wheat has been steadily rising across the country since the last 3 weeks, due to shortages reported from major wholesale markets.

Courses of Action: (I) The Government should set up an urgent investigation to check the reasons for the shortages. (II) The Government should provide oil at subsidized rates to citizens till wheat supplies are restored.
questions.solution:
Given:

**Statement**: The price of wheat has been steadily rising across the country since the last 3 weeks, due to shortages reported from major wholesale markets.

**Courses of Action:**

I. The Government should set up an urgent investigation to check the reasons for the shortages - **True** (Because it is essential to understand and address the root cause of the wheat shortage in order to stabilize prices).

II. The Government should provide oil at subsidized rates to citizens till wheat supplies are restored - **False** (Because providing oil at subsidized rates does not directly address the issue of wheat shortage and price rise).

So, **Only I follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, what will come in place of question mark ‘?’ in the following equation?

92 D 12 B 3 C (63 A 3) D 15 =?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 92 D 12 B 3 C (63 A 3) D 15 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 92 - 12 × 3 + (__**63 ÷ 3**__) - 15 = ?

⇒ 92 - __**12 × 3**__ + 21 - 15 = ?

⇒ __**92**__ - 36 __**+ 21**__ - 15 = ?

⇒ __**113 - 36 - 15**__ = 62.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".
